preconditions.description: The number of balls in Jacob's tree is between 2 and 200,000.
The number of balls the teacher will inspect is between 1 and n.
The time Jacob used to build the i-th ball is between 1 and 1,000,000.
Each connection between balls ui and vi is valid within the range of 1 to n.
Each connection between balls ui and vi is distinct and not the same ball.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the maximum grade Jacob can get.
